default.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days; a USD 10 tourist fee is collected in cash on arrival. Note that all of Haiti is under do-not-travel advisories because of gang violence.

groups.notes: CARICOM nationals enter under Caribbean Community free-movement arrangements — a definite entry of up to six months is granted on arrival.
Not covered by Haiti's visa waiver — a visa must be obtained from a Haitian mission before travelling; confirm current requirements with the embassy, as Haiti's list is not consistently published.

HT.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Haitian citizens.

TW.notes: Taiwan (ROC) passport holders enter visa-free for up to 90 days — Haiti is one of Taipei's remaining diplomatic partners. The USD 10 tourist fee still applies.
